name: Sphere Corp.
summary: Sphere Corp. is a provider of advanced digital healthcare technology and holistic life care products and services. A core offering is LifeRecord, a proprietary personal health record platform designed to centralize and manage various health data points, including medical histories, genomic information, and user-generated health metrics. The company also offers a suite of digital healthcare services directly to consumers, which includes virtual treatment options, medication oversight, and general health and wellness management. Furthermore, Sphere Corp. facilitates patient communities, leveraging digital health enablement through solutions like digital therapeutics and artificial intelligence-powered software medical devices. Its product portfolio extends to manufacturing consumer medical devices for home use, professional medical equipment for healthcare settings, and a selection of other consumer goods. Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 2012, the company operated as LifeSemantics Corp. until its rebranding to Sphere Corp. in April 2025.
